title: Item costs
description: Load the purchase cost of each item from a sheet. Opening stock takes these costs, and later reports value stock at them. Checking a file changes nothing.
fileHint: CSV (UTF-8) or Excel, up to 5,000 rows

rules.includesTax: Say for every row whether the purchase price includes GST (yes or no). When it does, enter the rate; the cost is taken without the tax.
rules.match: Items are found by variant_external_ref first, then by SKU. Names are never used.
rules.repeat: Loading the same file again changes nothing.

missingAfter: {{count}} tracked items would still have no cost: {{skus}}
moreIssues: Showing the first {{shown}}. Fix these and check the file again.
fixErrorsFirst: Fix every error and check the file again before loading.

spotCheck.title: Spot check: {{count}} rows
spotCheck.hint: Compare these rows with recent purchase bills before loading.

result.summary: Done: {{changed}} costs set now, {{alreadyDone}} set by an earlier load of this file, {{unchanged}} already at this cost.

errors.tooLarge: The file is larger than 5 MB; split it into smaller files.
errors.template: The template could not be downloaded.
errors.validate: The file could not be checked.
errors.commit: The costs could not be loaded.
